resolution.summary: Independently confirmed both reported keyboard defects using actual local v0.3.12 source, isolated alpha/beta Git fixtures, and Chrome via CUA. An unrelated createTask background event erased focused checkpoint and Summary drafts, leaving activeElement BODY. Both Escape and close-button Enter then left focus on BODY; no-background-update control preserved checkpoint text and returned focus to task card. Exact cited commit public/app.js read via GitHub connector has the same refresh/renderDetail innerHTML mechanism. Recommend preserving keyed drafts and stable DOM/focus, explicit semantic card focus restoration, and regression tests for both findings. No product source changes; fixture server stopped. Windows, screen readers and hosted dashboard not independently tested.
